cases.disposition_reason: Compare levels scrolls through 256 colors and 16 colors to no color at 120 by 40. After the terminal is 80 by 24 and the frame has settled, no color is still visible, and that frame is captured before the terminal grows. Turning compare off leaves Collapse below 80, Detail size resizable, Instance roster auto, and both behaviour toggles on.
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: Colour bands for the supported levels are visible, and the page state is unchanged after return.
cases.forbidden_effects: Leaving Compare levels changes the selected page or an option value.

cases.disposition_reason: Idle construction is not launching. The 80 by 24 clipped split is captured before the terminal grows. Launch sets Launching payments-platform… and adds e5d9 the-architect starting. A second click does not show A launch is already starting. Prewarm sets Prewarming the image…. A second click does not show Image prewarmed · next launch starts warm. Delete payments-platform? shows Type payments-platform to confirm and 3 instances stopped and purged, and that dialog is captured before it closes. Cancel sets Nothing deleted and keeps the workspace. Confirming the typed name sets Deleted payments-platform, leaves 3 saved workspaces, and removes payments-platform from the tree.
cases.action_sequence: Select a workspace and a roster entry. Launch, edit, prewarm, and delete. Collapse the detail and return.
cases.expected_results: Post-delete selection follows the documented fallback. The detail identity matches the selected workspace.
cases.forbidden_effects: Delete removes a workspace that was not selected.
